title: Recreator: Recycling PET Bottles into Filament for 3D Printers (Open Source Project)

information.value: Recycling PET bottles into 3D filament / Filament production at different speeds (300, 600, 900 mm/min) / Open source project with shared files and schematics / Mechanical parts sourced from an Ender 3 Pro / 3D-printed components (guide and gears) / Integrated control screen / Ventilation system and heating nozzle

Components from an Ender 3 Pro (screen, power supply, motors, nozzle, fan, aluminum profiles) / 3D-printed parts (guide and gears) / 3 custom G-code files for extrusion speed control / Microcontroller for process management / Open source software for design and control

description: Recreator is an open source project designed to recycle PET plastic bottles into filament suitable for 3D printers. The goal of this project is to democratize plastic recycling by providing an accessible and sustainable solution, allowing anyone to produce their own filament from household waste.

For the design, I reused the mechanical components from an Ender 3 Pro 3D printer, including the control screen, power supply, motors, heating nozzle, fan, and aluminum profiles for the frame. The gears and guide were 3D-printed, ensuring optimal integration and custom functionality.

The system produces filament at three different speeds (300 mm/min, 600 mm/min, and 900 mm/min), each managed by a custom G-code file. This flexibility allows the production process to be tailored to printing needs while maintaining consistent quality.

The entire project, including G-code files, design plans, and assembly instructions, is available as open source to encourage community collaboration and continuous improvement. The extrusion process, nozzle temperature, and motor speed are automated via a microcontroller, ensuring safe and stable operation.

This project allowed me to combine my skills in 3D printing, G-code programming, embedded electronics, and mechanical design, while contributing to a sustainable recycling initiative adapted for additive manufacturing.
